diff --git a/bash_completionsV2.go b/bash_completionsV2.go
index d295791e6..767bf0312 100644
--- a/bash_completionsV2.go
+++ b/bash_completionsV2.go
@@ -219,7 +219,7 @@ __%[1]s_handle_standard_completion_case() {
     local tab=$'\t' comp
 
     # Short circuit to optimize if we don't have descriptions
-    if [[ ${completions[*]} != *$tab* ]]; then
+    if [[ "${completions[*]}" != *$tab* ]]; then
         IFS=$'\n' read -ra COMPREPLY -d '' < <(compgen -W "${completions[*]}" -- "$cur")
         return 0
     fi
notes: Issue #1734 reports that tab characters introducing completion descriptions were mishandled with bash v3 in the generated completion script. Fixed by merged PR #1735 (merge commit 7c9831d376a6c048ae9f95b435cdde9dc14358a0). base_commit is the parent of that merge commit on master. gold_diff is the exact patch from PR #1735.
